runs.name: New Jersey Resources Corporation; NYSE NJR, SEC CIK 0000356309, New Jersey, fiscal year to September 30; New Jersey Natural Gas, Clean Energy Ventures, Energy Services, and Storage and Transportation (Leaf River, Adelphia, half of Steckman Ridge); residential solar portfolio sold 2024-11-25
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR
runs.entry: Price **$52.19** (close 2026-10-16, `tools/sources.py`, aggregator, flagged). Shares 101,467,946 common on the cover of the 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 (0000356309-26-000037, as of 2026-07-31), `Screens/cover_shares.py` agreeing, against 101,410,957 outstanding on that 10-Q's balance sheet, the difference continuous plan issuance; net debt $3,669.0M at 2026-06-30 with the solar sale-leaseback financing obligations kept in, operating leases left out, said so; the 8-K of 2026-08-20 ($150M of NJNG senior notes) treated as neutral to net debt. Sovereign **5.43%**, the US Treasury 30-year par yield of 2026-10-16 (`tools/sources.py`, issuing authority). Read from the 10-K for FY2025 (0000356309-25-000093), the 10-Q to 2026-06-30, the proxy of 2025-12-10 (0000356309-25-000096), the 8-Ks of 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-20 and the 10-Ks for FY2017 to FY2023. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7, ten lines each with its item, stated in the run file. `tools/run.py`'s owner-earnings window stopped at FY2019 (capital spending untagged under its names after that) and its debt column included equity; both replaced by the filed statements. **Q1 IN**: New Jersey Natural Gas decides at 54.8% of FY2021 to FY2025 segment net financial earnings (Energy Services 24.5%, Clean Energy Ventures 14.7%); a doubt on the wholesale trading arm recorded, not deciding. **Q2 IN**: a franchise no rival attacks at a regulator-set ordinary return (the order of 2024-11-21: 9.6% on equity, 7.08% on rate base), carried to Q3 as a second best; the State's executive orders and its proceeding on the future of gas utilities recorded as the closest call of the run, TOO HARD (NATURE) named as the other reading, the box not depending on it. **Q3 weighs against**: capital spending 4.1 times depreciation over FY2021 to FY2025, operating cash covering spending in one year of ten (FY2018), about 7% after tax on added capital. **Q4 weighs against, no STOP**: accounts clean, the FY2021 change to deferral of investment tax credits the conservative way; ten balance sheets read, debt up 2.9 times to $3.60bn, 51% to 60% of debt plus equity, year-end cash under $5M in eight of ten years, regulatory assets $721M; the featured non-GAAP per-share figure, its guidance and a segment EBITDA carried to Q5. **Q5 integrity IN, ability weighs for, narrowly**: guidance beats traced to disclosed GAAP events, a one-time sale gain removed from the pay measure by the board. **Q6 weighs against on both parts**: FY2018 to FY2025 $1,305M kept or raised against $1,190M of market value made; the dividend paid while shares are sold; pay on per-share earnings with no capital charge and relative total return; the FY2021 buyback ($27.2M) above the whole range, written back at Q7. **Q7 OUT on the floor**: owner cash FY2021 to FY2025 after stock pay, all spending, -$174M a year after interest and -$96M all-equity; maintenance by the depreciation-plus-removal proxy $209M and $287M; not a serial acquirer, so no organic-pair figure; best expected return at the price 3.20% on enterprise value (3.94% equity-only), 4.36% on a halves-rate growth case not held central. Value range **-$18.22 to $15.91 a share** all-equity at the sovereign (equity-only $5.26 to $37.87), the growth case below the no-growth case because (f) cuts growth to revenue growth of -1.42% on pass-through gas revenue (uncapped bottom -$0.61); fair price **-$20.77 all-equity, not positive**, $8.03 equity-only. The 10-K names no rival; Atmos, ONE Gas and Northwest Natural chosen as a CONVENTION of the run: FY2021 to FY2025 average return on equity 9.0%, 8.5% and 7.7%, NJNG alone estimated near 8%, NJR's consolidated 13.1% from trading and solar tax credits. Contamination declared by the analyst: MDU commit subjects at dispatch, one `Test Runs/` listing showing the HOKCY, MDU and XNGSY run names, memory index lines; none used. **Write-early defect declared by the analyst**: from the Q3 to the Q7 commit an append script truncated the run file, so those commits hold only the newest sections; each section was committed the same minute as a draft in the research folder, and the closing commit rebuilt the file from the Q2 commit and the drafts; the dispatcher checked the drafts for Q3, Q4, Q5 and Q7 as contained verbatim in the final file and Q6 differing only by the Q7 buyback write-back. Commits 1ae70f37 (template), 9637fe47 (Step 0 and Q1), 394d403c (Q2), dbb96372 (Q3), 072b9caf (Q4), ecf8ac1d (Q5), 0641515e (Q6), cc4dbc50 (Q7 with the buyback line written back), 34b75b55 (the rest and the rebuild). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_run_ids.py` 0 problems; the dispatcher's `_dispatcher_cite_check.py` 67 ids, no E-ids, 44 quoted fragments beside an id, 0 slips; **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (f)'s cap on revenue for a pass-through utility, revenue as filed or utility margin; which growth rate to carry under (e) when end-years and halves differ; the regulated-return exception when the threat is the regulator's own State; EBITDA between Q4's STOP and Q5's weighing; whether a utility's deferred taxes are a shelter to price or ordinary cash; the template's issued-less-treasury share check where the balance sheet states outstanding shares. Not armed: the all-equity fair is not positive and the run reports no organic-pair figure (not a serial acquirer); the equity-only $8.03 alert is left to the operator. Could not get: the statutory-tax schedule with the credit shelter (direction shown, top to $5.22, box unmoved), NJNG's maintenance and growth split (an image in the 10-K), NJNG's own equity, ONE Gas depreciation, the FY2021 buyback prices, whether stock pay sits inside operating cash (at most $17.8M a year double-counted), the outcome of the State's proceeding.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7, on the floor (New Jersey Resources, NYSE NJR, New Jersey Natural Gas with solar, wholesale energy services and storage and pipelines; Q1 IN, the gas utility decides at 54.8%; Q2 IN, a franchise at a regulator-set 9.6% on equity carried as a second best, the State's proceeding on the future of gas utilities the closest call, TOO HARD (NATURE) the other reading; Q3, Q4 and Q6 against: spending 4.1 times depreciation, operating cash covering spending one year in ten, debt to 60% of capital, the dividend paid while shares are sold; Q5 integrity IN, ability for, narrowly. Best expected return 3.20% on enterprise value at $52.19; value range -$18.22 to $15.91 a share at the 5.43% Treasury rate; fair price -$20.77 all-equity, not positive, $8.03 equity-only; not armed, the equity-only alert left to the operator. No citation slip; a write-early defect declared and repaired from committed drafts. Framework gaps for the operator: (f)'s cap on pass-through revenue, the growth rate under (e), the State as the threat to a regulated castle, deferred taxes in Whose tax.)
